== Biography ==
{{Ireland Native}}
Francis was the brother of [[Glasgow-2540|Hugh Glasgow (abt.1805-abt.1900)]] of Carleton, Nova Scotia; 
<ref name="f"/>
which would likely make him the son of [[Glasgow-2539|John Glasgow]] of Gortin, Derryloran, County Tyrone. 

He passed away 22 December 1869 abt. age 70 in  a shipwreck.
<ref name="f">{{FindAGrave|228144829}} - cites obituary describing the shipwreck and family circumstances.</ref>

He is buried in the same plot at Fernhill Cemetery, St. John, as Sarah MacNeece Glasgow (possibly his mother?)
